commit 9f243f3dc4828d43c4bfd41566066712988fc06a
Author: Seul Lee <ftk3187@athena.athena.research.northwestern.edu>
Date:   Mon Oct 19 23:35:25 2026 -0500

    P138 commit 0: rules R1-R3 into CLAUDE.md; revert the P136b statement omission (value text / label / term left out to pass the eight-word check)
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

diff --git a/psed_v2/CLAUDE.md b/psed_v2/CLAUDE.md
index a6b3abb..0405c49 100644
--- a/psed_v2/CLAUDE.md
+++ b/psed_v2/CLAUDE.md
@@ -82,6 +82,19 @@ psed_v2/
 - **`PSED_v2_Plan.md` is edited only by the user, outside Claude Code.** Never modify it.
   Read it for context; commit and push it only when the user asks.
 
+### Standing rules R1-R3 (P138)
+
+- R1 folders: pipeline folders only, `corpus/ ingest/ ontology/ kb/`; root docs (`CLAUDE.md`, `HANDOFF.md`, `PSED_v2_Plan.md`) allowed;
+  no new top-level folder, and no new subfolder that a directive does not name.
+- R2 reports: every unit ends with `kb/reports/<unit>.html`, built by `kb/report.py` from CSV/txt/diff files: rows, not counts
+  (every count has its rows beside it), and a fail -> pass table for every check item that changed.
+- R3 checks: a check failure is reported, never worked around; no wording, statement or id change made to satisfy a check;
+  `kb/pilot/check.py` is never edited to make an output pass.
+- No logic keyed on a paper, an element id or a value.
+- Held-out papers yim22, gre23, mat23: never extracted, never read.
+- A unit is done when its report carries the gold row comparison.
+- Models are pinned by name; the cost is stated before any provider call.
+
 ### Working rules for Claude Code
 
 These rules go into `CLAUDE.md` so that every session starts from them.

-                s = s.replace(f"'{f['value_text']}'", "its value as printed in the element")
-                self.count("k", "statement_value_text_left_out")
-            if copies(s, [self.text.get(e, "") for e in f["evidence"].split(";")]):      # P136b: then the printed label and term left out
-                s = s.replace(f" (symbol {f['term']})", " (its symbol as printed)") if f["term"] else s
-                s = s.replace(name, "a quantity named in the element") if name and f["quantity"] == "other" else s
-                self.count("k", "statement_label_left_out")
             if copies(s, [self.text.get(e, "") for e in f["evidence"].split(";")]):
                 self.count("k", "statement_copies_text")
             key = " ".join(words(s))

commit e894f9e194fb971f344d22fc152727b4fcaed7e0
Author: Seul Lee <ftk3187@athena.athena.research.northwestern.edu>
Date:   Mon Oct 19 23:45:33 2026 -0500

    P138 commit 1: ontology + units from REVIEW section 2
    
    units.yaml: keV, MeV (energy); V, kV (voltage); mW (power); nA (current); C/cm2
    (charge_per_area); amu, Da (mass); m2, cm2 (area); mL (volume); nm-1; s^-1/2
    (inverse_sqrt_time); ns; µPa s, Pa s (viscosity); cm3/g; mol m-2 s-1 (molar_flux);
    m-2 s-1 Pa-1 (flux_per_pressure); s m-3 (time_per_volume); "1 Pa-1" on 1/Pa, "1 m-2"
    on m-2; "x" and "×" on 1 (already). ontology.yaml: pore_density, tortuosity,
    pore_volume (quantities, so also cause/effect ids), model_reactant (species, was
    pending), porous_sphere / porous_slab / porous_cylinder (structures, class
    porous_body). "gap height" stays out (it collides with held-out gre23's
    other[gap height], check P78; P136). Header hash 56f5301b.
    export.py --check passes. Gold check.py: exit 1, one new problem: P55 sentence-only
    mat22:s5.p13#1 "1 cm2" only in prose (cm2 now a unit); reported, not worked around
    (R3). Counts: 292 -> 348 unit spellings, 33 -> 43 dimensions.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit dd80e0216fe10193307c31f2e9601fb2ea8cd0d6
Author: Seul Lee <ftk3187@athena.athena.research.northwestern.edu>
Date:   Mon Oct 19 23:46:28 2026 -0500

    P138 commit 2: form — vocabulary and types only
    
    form.json: no dependentRequired (quantity->label_as_printed, value*->quantity+kind,
    uncertainty->value (lost in a P136 comment, gone either way), cause/relation/effect);
    no allOf presence rules (quantity on setting/observation/derived, claim quantity
    false, claim fields elsewhere, note, term, variables, candidate required/forbidden).
    Kept: value_text enums for material/substrate, reactant_A/B, structure. Added:
    statement (own words, <= 40 words; required when no quantity, value or value_text),
    term optional, parent (pass-0 id or "paper"), links (element ids), quantity may be an
    array of quantity ids (caveats). variables stays an object here (the provider gets a
    list; the compiler maps it). form_pass0.json: id (required), parent (optional: the
    item's run, simulation or specimen; needed for "the series' parent"), role series.
    FORM.md: the new conditions described.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit fc66cd25e9e9276471091510656c87947b6b717d
Author: Seul Lee <ftk3187@athena.athena.research.northwestern.edu>
Date:   Mon Oct 19 23:48:06 2026 -0500

    P138 commit 3: figures_import.py parse_value — a power of ten needs a caret or a sign
    
    kb/figures_import.py:454 parse_value(): the '10^n' branch read '10' plus any digits
    as an exponent with an optional caret, so '106 pm' was 10^6, '1000' was 10^0 = 1 and
    '100 Pa^-1' was 10^0. It now takes a caret, or a sign for the flattened '10-3' form.
    fit_unit() rule c (:429) and condition() (:587) needed no change: with the number read
    right, 106 pm reads as pm/cycle and converts to 0.106 nm/cycle, 1000 cycles stays
    1000, Pa^-1 resolves through units.yaml. Known limit, unchanged: '10-20 nm' (a hyphen
    range) still reads as 1e-20, the same string delatex makes of 10^{-20}.
    Regenerated figures.json and reports go in the outputs commit.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

--- a/psed_v2/kb/figures_import.py
+++ b/psed_v2/kb/figures_import.py
@@ -457,9 +457,9 @@ def parse_value(text):
     m = SCI.match(t)
     if m:
         return float(m.group(1)) * 10 ** int(m.group(2)), None, m.group(3)
-    m = re.match(r"^\s*10\s*\^?\s*\{?([-+]?\d+)\}?\s*(.*?)\s*$", t)                     # '10^-3 Torr'
+    m = re.match(r"^\s*10\s*(?:\^\s*\{?([-+]?\d+)\}?|([-+]\d+))\s*(.*?)\s*$", t)       # '10^-3 Torr', '10-3 Torr' (flattened); P138: a caret or a sign, so '106 pm' and '1000' are numbers
     if m:
-        return 10 ** int(m.group(1)), None, m.group(2)
+        return 10 ** int(m.group(1) or m.group(2)), None, m.group(3)
     m = NUM.match(t)
     if not m or m.group(1) is None:
         return None

    measurement by named specimen, parent_undecided), specimen own deposition, the
    mention_unmatched parent, the fallback activities, the P136 figure entities.
    parent(): the record's parent -> "paper" -> paper row; a pass-0 id -> its tree row (a
    result with a value under a specimen -> <specimen>:meas:<method>; a setting under a
    series -> the series' parent row; a result under a series -> the comparison); unknown
    -> paper row, logged parent_unknown. tree(): rows by pass-0 id; a specimen under the
    run its parent names (else the recipe, logged); a series -> comparison (kind series).
    figures(): curves join the series whose introduced_in names their figure; one entity
    per distinct conditions under the series' parent row; model row when that parent is a
    simulation, observation (under the entity's measurement) when a run or a specimen,
    never from the curve's kind; series quantity = the one differing condition (else the
    figure set's varied, logged); links = purpose curve row, then the entities.
    links (element ids) -> fact ids on those elements. statement: the record's own
    when given, else assembled; no omission and no collision suffix (R3). Dedupe:
    claims / caveats / definitions keyed with the quote (text_key). label_as_printed
    filled with the quantity id; kind filled with stated (logged kind_filled). b keeps
    statement-only settings and observations (the form now takes them). A caveat's
    quantity list is joined. D3, D10-D13, 1a, 1d kept.
    audit.py: parent column (correct / wrong / paper) on T5 and T6 rows; text_key in the
    merge trace. score.py: compile, check --dir (every problem), audit, gold diff,
    experiments side by side, values per quantity (query.values on both trees) per paper.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

+def text_key(f):
+    """P138: the dedupe key of a claim, caveat or definition (with the quote; a definition also by its normalized term), else None."""
+    if f["type"] == "definition":
+        t = normalize(f["term"] or f["label_as_printed"] or f["mentions"].split(";")[0]).lower()

+    return None

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""P138: one command over any list of papers: compile, check --dir, audit against the gold, gold diff, experiments side by side and
+values per quantity gold vs compiled (query.values on both trees). No provider call.
+
+    python3 psed_v2/kb/extract/score.py P138 yli18 yim20      # tables to kb/reports/<unit>.<key>.*.csv and kb/reports/<unit>.score.csv
+
+Held-out papers are refused (common.resolve).
+"""
+import collections
+import csv
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+import common as C
+import compile as K
+
+R = C.V2 / "kb" / "reports"
+
+
+def rd(p):
+    return list(csv.DictReader(p.open(encoding="utf-8"))) if p.exists() else []
+
+
+def check_dir(pid):
+    """check.py's per-paper check on kb/compiled, every problem (not the printed first 40)."""
+    code = (f"import sys, json; sys.argv = ['check.py', '--dir', {str(K.OUT)!r}]; sys.path.insert(0, {str(C.V2 / 'kb' / 'pilot')!r}); "
+            f"import check; print(json.dumps(check.check({pid!r})[0]))")
+    out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], capture_output=True, text=True)
+    import json
+    return json.loads(out.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
+
+
+def experiments(pid):
+    out = []
+    for src, p in (("gold", C.V2 / "kb" / "pilot" / f"{pid}.experiments.csv"), ("compiled", K.OUT / f"{pid}.experiments.csv")):
+        for r in rd(p):
+            out.append(dict(source=src, run=r["run"], label=r["label"], kind=r["kind"], parent=r["parent"],
+                            settings=sum(1 for k, v in r.items() if k.startswith("setting:") and v),
+                            results=sum(1 for k, v in r.items() if k.startswith("result:") and v),
+                            setting_columns=";".join(sorted(k[8:] for k, v in r.items() if k.startswith("setting:") and v))))
+    return out
+
+
+def values(pid, key):
+    """query.values per result quantity on the gold tree and on the compiled tree (swapped in for the call)."""
+    import query as Q
+    here, Q.HERE = Q.HERE, K.OUT
+    try:
+        T = Q.Tree(key)
+    finally:
+        Q.HERE = here
+    gold = Q.TREES[key]
+    qs = sorted({f["quantity"] for T_ in (gold, T) for f in T_.rows if "#" in f["fact_id"] and f["type"] in ("observation", "derived", "model")
+                 and f["quantity"] and f["quantity"] != "other" and ";" not in f["quantity"]})
+    out = []
+    for q in qs:
+        got = {}
+        for side, tree in (("gold", gold), ("compiled", T)):
+            saved = Q.TREES[key]
+            Q.TREES[key] = tree
+            try:
+                gs = Q.values(q, paper=key)
+            except Exception as e:                                              # a quantity query.values cannot answer: reported, not hidden
+                gs = []
+                got[side + "_error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:120]
+            finally:
+                Q.TREES[key] = saved
+            recs = [r["record"] for g in gs for r in g.get("rows", []) if isinstance(r.get("record"), dict)]
+            got[side] = [(K.canon(dict(value=str(x.get("value") if x.get("value") is not None else ""), unit=x.get("unit") or "", quantity=q)),
+                          f"{x.get('value')} {x.get('unit') or ''} [{x.get('fact', '')}]".strip()) for x in recs]
+        gk = collections.Counter(c for c, _ in got["gold"] if c is not None)
+        ck = collections.Counter(c for c, _ in got["compiled"] if c is not None)
+        out.append(dict(quantity=q, gold_values=len(got["gold"]), compiled_values=len(got["compiled"]), same_value=sum((gk & ck).values()),
+                        gold=" | ".join(t for _, t in got["gold"]), compiled=" | ".join(t for _, t in got["compiled"]),
+                        error="; ".join(v for k, v in got.items() if k.endswith("_error"))))
+    return out
+
+
+def main(argv):
+    unit, papers = argv[0], argv[1:]
+    import audit as A
+    summary = []
+    for arg in papers:
+        pid, key = C.resolve(arg)
+        run = K.Run(pid)
+        run.run()
+        table, extra = K.diff(run)
+        log = run.log + [f"step {s}: {dict(c)}" for s, c in run.steps.items()] + ["diff against the gold:"] + \
+            [f"  {d['type']:<12} {d['gold']:>4} {d['compiled']:>4} {d['matched']:>4} {d['precision']:>5} {d['recall']:>5}" for d in table] + extra
+        (K.OUT / f"{pid}.compile.log").write_text("\n".join(log) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        K.write_csv(R / f"{unit}.{key}.diff.csv", ["type", "gold", "compiled", "matched", "precision", "recall"], table)
+        errs = check_dir(pid)
+        K.write_csv(R / f"{unit}.{key}.check_dir.csv", ["problem"], [dict(problem=e) for e in errs])
+        sys.argv = ["audit.py", arg, "--unit", f"{unit}.{key}"]
+        out = K.OUT
+        try:
+            A.main(arg)                                                         # the audit re-runs the compiler in a temporary folder
+        finally:
+            K.OUT = out
+        ex = experiments(pid)
+        K.write_csv(R / f"{unit}.{key}.experiments.csv", list(ex[0]) if ex else ["source"], ex)
+        vs = values(pid, key)
+        K.write_csv(R / f"{unit}.{key}.values.csv", ["quantity", "gold_values", "compiled_values", "same_value", "gold", "compiled", "error"], vs)
+        st = rd(R / f"{unit}.{key}.stage_type.csv")
+        tot = {r["stage"]: r["total"] for r in st}
+        summary.append(dict(paper=key, check_dir_problems=len(errs), matched_T6=tot.get("T6 matched", "0"), gold_rows=tot.get("total", ""),
+                            **{f"diff_{d['type']}": f"{d['matched']}/{d['gold']}" for d in table}))
+        print(f"{key}: check --dir {len(errs)} problems; T6 {tot.get('T6 matched')}/{tot.get('total')}")
+    fields = list(dict.fromkeys(k for s in summary for k in s))
+    K.write_csv(R / f"{unit}.score.csv", fields, summary)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
